name: Arthur
description: The show revolves around the lives of 8-year-old Arthur Read, an anthropomorphic aardvark, his friends and family, and their daily interactions with each other.

videos.title: Arthur's Perfect Christmas
videos.overview: Plans are under way in Elwood City for the best holidays ever! Arthur, D.W., their friends and family make preparations for perfect gifts, perfect parties, and perfect family traditions for Christmas, Hanukkah and Kwanzaa. But, just as in real life, perfection cannot last and things begin to fall apart. Arthur learns that the joy in Christmas isn't found in an artificial vision of the perfect holiday season, but in the wonderfully messy, imperfect world he lives in.

videos.title: It's Only Rock 'n' Roll
videos.overview: The Backstreet Boys are coming to Elwood City! While Muffy fantasizes about meeting her idol, Nick Carter, Francine gripes about everyone's infatuation with a bunch of sellouts. Fed up with the hype, Francine forms her own anti-sellout band, U Stink. But when U Stink becomes an overnight sensation, the band suffers from an identity crisis and Francine quits in a huff. Will U Stink rise to stardom without Francine? Will the Backstreet Boys make Muffy their manager?

videos.title: Arthur and Buster Thanksgiving Spectacular
videos.overview:
Aired on PBS on Thanksgiving Day, November 24, 2005, this two-hour special featured several Arthur stories and two complete episodes of Postcards from Buster. This special featured interstitial postcard segments from Buster, segments with kids from the show Zoom (Taylor and Kyle) and a small additional factoid regarding Arthur and Buster. At the end of the special, a secret password for The Tibble Super Action Challenge, a new game at the official PBS Kids Arthur website was revealed.

The Arthur stories shown were:

"Buster's Green Thumb"

"Dad's Dessert Dilemma"

"Thanks a Lot, Binky"

"The Ballad of Buster Baxter"

The Postcards from Buster episodes shown were:

"Best Friends"

"Among the Hmong"

videos.title: Arthur's Missing Pal
videos.overview: The first-ever Arthur movie. In Arthur's Missing Pal, Arthur's dog, Pal, goes missing. Arthur and Buster are certain that D.W. did it, but D.W. denies any involvement. Arthur and his friends mount a search throughout Elwood City for the missing dog.

videos.title: D.W. and the Beastly Birthday
videos.overview: In this all-new Arthur movie event, D.W.’s fifth birthday doesn’t go the way she had always imagined it would and she chose to escape to the magical island of Ukubonga. Meanwhile, Arthur has skipped her birthday party to go on a school trip to the planetarium – but instead of transporting him into outer space, it transports him four years in the future!

videos.title: The Rhythm and Roots of Arthur
videos.overview: Pack your bags, buckle your seatbelts, and get ready for an ARTHUR road trip to the family farm! Arthur's Great-Grand Uncle Theo is celebrating his 85th birthday, so the Reads (and Buster) are off to Ohio to join in the festivities. While D.W. and Arthur learn that farm life is a little different than life in Elwood City, Buster worries he may be getting in the way at this family reunion. With the help of Cousin Miles, some llamas, and a little bit of music, they all discover what it truly means to be family.

videos.title: An Arthur Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Arthur and his family are getting ready for Thanksgiving! But when Pal disappears to go on his own adventure, family, friends and the rest of Elwood City try to get Pal home. Will they be able to celebrate the best Thanksgiving yet?

videos.title: Arthur's First Day
videos.overview: It's finally the first day of fourth grade and Arthur couldn't be more excited -until he learns Buster is in another class! Meanwhile, D.W. is nervous for her first day of kindergarten. Will Arthur and D.W. be able to make new friends?

videos.title: Arthur's Eyes
videos.overview: Arthur is embarrassed because he now has to wear glasses.

videos.title: Francine's Bad Hair Day
videos.overview: Francine tries to get through picture day, without messing up her meticulously-crafted hairdo.

videos.title: Arthur and the Real Mr. Ratburn
videos.overview: Arthur and Buster fear that their new teacher, Mr. Ratburn, is some kind of evil maniac who collects children's heads - until they discover the truth about him, of course.

videos.title: Arthur's Spelling Trubble
videos.overview: Arthur does some heavy-duty studying, in order to compete in the school's upcoming spelling bee.

videos.title: D.W. All Wet
videos.overview: Whew, boy is it HOT today. The Reads decide to head to the beach in order to cool off, but D.W. refuses to go along (she thinks there is an octopus in the water).

videos.title: Buster's Dino Dilemma
videos.overview: When the class goes on a field trip to a dinosaur museum, Buster finds a fossil on the ground - and wants to keep it for himself.

videos.title: D.W.'s Imaginary Friend
videos.overview: D.W. has an imaginary friend, Nadine, says she has to come everywhere, but Arthur is sick of it.

videos.title: Arthur's Lost Library Book
videos.overview: When Arthur checks out a library book and loses it a week later; he thinks he is banned from the library. So he and Binky team up to find it.

videos.title: Arthur's Pet Business
videos.overview: When Arthur desperately wants a dog, he starts a pet business. When he gets too many he decides to just take care of one pet.

videos.title: D.W. the Copycat
videos.overview: When D.W. gets told she doesn't like any interesting stuff, she decides to copy Arthur.

videos.title: Locked in the Library!
videos.overview: After Arthur called Francine a marshmallow, Francine and her friends get really mad and it looks like they are going to fight. But when they both get locked inside the Elwood City Library they either have to make up, or prepare for a long and scary weekend, because it's the weekend and the library closes until Monday.

videos.title: Arthur Accused!
videos.overview: Arthur had a job to collect coins for Mrs. McGrady to raise money for a new dog for the Elwood City firemen, and when he left the bag of quarters where Mrs. McGrady was working, she said she never received them. While this was happening, Buster opened his detective agency, he has no idea his first job will involve Arthur. Now, it is up to Buster to solve this mystery, was Arthur the real thief?....

videos.title: Arthur Goes to Camp
videos.overview: Arthur and his friends go to summer camp and Binky brings up the issue that it's boys vs. girls. The other team participating always won because of this problem, so now the kids of Elwood must work together to defeat them this year.

videos.title: Buster Makes the Grade
videos.overview: Buster's grades aren't as good as his jokes, and now he is on the verge of repeating his third grade year. If he does not receive at least a B on his next test, he fails...

videos.title: Arthur's New Puppy
videos.overview: Arthur has a new puppy is exactly what he wanted. But the only problem is that he destroys everything in sight, so can Arthur teach Pal to behave, before his parents do something with Pal because of all the disasters he is causing.

videos.title: Arthur Bounces Back
videos.overview: Arthur's dream is to have Moon shoes, but he does not have the ten dollars to get them. When he begins working chores to receive money, he got too desperate and does something he will regret.

videos.title: Arthur Babysits
videos.overview: Arthur has plenty of gripes about his past babysitters, but soon finds himself trying his hand at some babysitting of his own. He ends up having the Tibble Twins' Grandma ask him to babysit the infamous Tibble Twins and he agrees to the job. Despite the warnings from both his friends and D.W., he takes on the task and quickly finds himself overwhelmed. After some quick thinking, and a willingness to keep at things, he comes up with a plan.

videos.title: Arthur's Cousin Catastrophe
videos.overview: The Read Family is having a big reunion, with aardvark relatives from all over coming. Arthur normally enjoys the festivities, such as sack-racing and swapping stories, but finds himself hiding because he's worried that his cousin Mo has a big practical joke planned for him. He remembers her being awful to him in the past and is sure that she has something big planned. However, his worries might just be unfounded.

videos.title: Arthur's Birthday
videos.overview: Arthur is excited about his birthday. After shopping for party supplies, he makes invitations and passes them out at school. He then finds out that Muffy is having her party on the same day, at the same time. This starts a huge battle between the boys and the girls in the Ratburn class. Fortunately, Francine and Arthur devise a great solution to the problem.

videos.title: Francine Frensky, Superstar
videos.overview: Francine has always gotten the worst roles in school plays, so everyone in the Ratburn class asks Mr. Ratburn to give her a good part in the next one. The play is about Thomas Edison, and Francine is given the role of Edison himself. She takes her role very seriously, to the point where she starts to trying to run everything her way and insults her friends. After the hurt and the anger, they set out to show her that she can't just forget their needs

videos.title: Arthur's Baby
videos.overview: Viewers are taken back, as Arthur and D.W. recollect what happened when Baby Kate was first-born. D.W. is excited with anticipation, but Arthur is very worried. His worries are only made worse when his friends tell him about all the awful stuff that's going to happen when the baby comes. Still, Arthur, is determined to be a good big brother, but ends up thinking that the baby hates him!

videos.title: D.W.'s Baby
videos.overview: D.W. was excited to have a new little sister, but when she doesn't get to help much and the baby moves into her room, things don't seem so great. Kate stinks and makes a lot of noise. D.W. hatches a plan to get rid of her, but finds that maybe being a big sister isn't so bad after all.

videos.title: Arthur Writes a Story
videos.overview: Mr. Ratburn gives the class an assignment --- to write a story about anything they want. It seems like a simple assignment and it doesn't even have to be bound and sent to a publisher as Muffy suggests. Arthur, however, finds it a hard task when he starts trying to write to please everyone's tastes. He starts out with the simple story of how he got his dog Pal, but after following the advice of each of his friends, it morphs into a bizarre country tune about baby elephants being born in outer space.

videos.title: Arthur's Lost Dog
videos.overview: When Pal runs away at a street fair, even Arthur starts to doubt his dog's intelligence.

videos.title: So Long, Spanky
videos.overview: D.W. suffers through the death of her beloved bird, then has to decide whether to risk her heart again by adopting a lonely toad.

videos.title: Buster's New Friend
videos.overview: Arthur is lonely when Buster starts spending time with a new super-cool friend named Mike.

videos.title: Arthur the Wrecker
videos.overview: Arthur breaks his mom's computer. Can he fix it before she finds out?

videos.title: Arthur and the True Francine
videos.overview: Muffy and Francine are absolute best friends. It seems nothing can come between them, until Muffy cheats on a math test and lets Francine take the blame.

videos.title: Arthur's Family Vacation
videos.overview: A rainy family vacation wasn't what Arthur had in mind; Camp Meadowcroak was more like it. As Arthur discovers, however, there are 101 fun things to do in the rain.

videos.title: Grandpa Dave's Old Country Farm
videos.overview: Arthur and D.W. spend a week at their grandfather's farm, which isn't quite as Arthur remembers it.

videos.title: Arthur and the Crunch Cereal Contest
videos.overview: Arthur's sure he can win a year's supply of Crunch Cereal by entering a jingle in their contest. The only problem is his song seems to be lacking something; words and melody, to be exact.

videos.title: D.W. Flips
videos.overview: It's hard enough for D.W. to do somersaults and cartwheels without having a showoff like Emily in gymnastics class. But D.W. learns about tumbling, and friendship, anyway.

videos.title: Meek for a Week
videos.overview: Muffy challenges Francine to be nice, and not to say insulting things, for one week. The trouble is, the gang begins to worry that Francine isn't herself.

videos.title: Arthur, World's Greatest Gleeper
videos.overview: Arthur thinks it would be cool to be a Gleeper and win the admiration of the tough kids at school. Too late he finds out that "gleeping" means stealing!

videos.title: Arthur's Chicken Pox
videos.overview: The circus is in town, and the whole family's excited: Father gets tickets, Mother gets film for the camera and Arthur gets. . . chicken pox! D.W. is jealous of all the attention he gets, but will Arthur make it to the circus?

videos.title: Sick as a Dog
videos.overview: Pal is sick, and Arthur is sure it's D.W.'s fault. After all, it couldn't have anything to do with the hotdogs and Halloween candy Arthur's been feeding him, could it?

videos.title: D.W. Rides Again
videos.overview: The bikeathon is coming and D.W. wants to ride in it. With Arthur's help, D.W. embarks on a crash course to learn the rules of the road.

videos.title: Arthur Makes the Team
videos.overview: It's baseball season, and Arthur and the gang are a team. With some practice, and some coaching from Francine, they may just stand a chance.

videos.title: Arthur's Almost Boring Day
videos.overview: It's a rainy Saturday, and Arthur is stuck with D.W. and nothing to do; to make matters worse, Arthur has to report on Monday about how he spent the day. A foray into Grandma Thora's attic, however, reveals some fascinating stuff about Arthur's parents.

videos.title: The Half-Baked Sale
videos.overview: Grandma Thora has agreed to help on the local bake sale, but Arthur and D.W. worry what people will think when they discover Grandma Thora's terrible cooking. Arthur considers how to keep Grandma Thora's "goodies" out of sight without hurting her feelings.

videos.title: Sue Ellen Moves In
videos.overview: Sue Ellen's family has just moved into the neighborhood, and the gang is convinced they're either spies, criminals, or aliens. Finally, everyone realizes that Sue Ellen isn't all that different-- except for Buster, who needs some extra convincing.

videos.title: The Perfect Brother
videos.overview: It seemed like a great idea to have Brain spend the weekend. But Arthur finds it's very hard being around someone who's almost perfect; or, at least, someone who seems to be.

videos.title: D.W.'s Snow Mystery
videos.overview: Much to her distress, D.W.'s most prized possession--a snowball from last winter--is missing. Arthur and the gang try to piece together an explanation.

videos.title: Team Trouble
videos.overview: Arthur, Francine, and Buster have to do a history report on ancient Rome. Working together as a team presents some serious challenges.

videos.title: Bully for Binky
videos.overview: Binky is the toughest kid in school and everyone is afraid of him.

videos.title: Misfortune Teller
videos.overview: Prunella has a fortune-telling "cootie catcher," and all the kids want to know their futures. Yet, somehow, it seems as if the fortune teller has begun to make everyone's decisions for them.

videos.title: Arthur's Tooth
videos.overview: When Arthur is teased by Francine and the others because he hasn't lost all of his baby teeth yet,  he becomes determined to lose his tooth and fit in with the others.

videos.title: D.W. Gets Lost
videos.overview: Being lost in a humongous, super-giganto department store would scare most four-year-olds....but not D.W. Lost while searching for the earrings of her dreams, D.W. wreaks havoc as she tries to find her way home.

videos.title: D.W. Thinks Big
videos.overview: D.W. finds Aunt Lucy's wedding ring after she lost it at her wedding.

videos.title: Arthur Cleans Up
videos.overview: Elwood City's park is in sad shape. After grumbling about it, the kids find themselves volunteering to clean it up. Even though it's a lot of work, in the end they all decide it feels great to make a difference.

videos.title: My Dad, the Garbage Man
videos.overview: Every kid at school's parents has cool jobs except for Francine's dad. He's a garbage man and Francine is embarrassed by it so to make him look cool she tells the kids at school that he's a CIA agent.

videos.title: Poor Muffy
videos.overview: A new carpet and an attack of sneezing means Muffy must spend the weekend at Francine's. But the Frensky house sure is hard to get used to: no cable TV, no limo, and they even eat leftovers!

videos.title: D.W.'s Blankie
videos.overview: D.W. loses her blankie and she and Arthur search all over town just to find it.

videos.title: Arthur's Substitute Teacher Trouble
videos.overview: Mr. Ratburn is sick, and the class is thrilled to have a substitute until they find out who she is: Ms. Rodentia Ratburn, Mr. Ratburn's younger sister. Suddenly, Mr. Ratburn doesn't seem so bad.

videos.title: I'm a Poet
videos.overview: Fern dares everyone to write a good poem for a contest. If the loser backs out they have to join art club for a year.

videos.title: The Scare-Your-Pants-Off Club!
videos.overview: Arthur and his friends develop a consuming passion for the Scare-Your-Pants-Off books, a series of hair-raising, spine-tingling ghost stories. When a group called PAWS, "Parent Against Weird Stories," tries to take the books off the library's shelves, Arthur and his friends decide to speak out.

videos.title: My Club Rules
videos.overview: The Strawberry Festival is coming to town and Arthur and his friends all band together and form a club to create the perfect float, but when everyone gets their own ideas on what the float should be they all form their own clubs.

videos.title: Stolen Bike
videos.overview: Francine is so determined to get a shiny new bike that she finally decides to let her old one get "stolen."

videos.title: Arthur's First Sleepover
videos.overview: Arthur throws a sleepover and invites Brain and Buster. He doesen't invite D.W. so she decides to ruin the sleepover.

videos.title: Arthur's New Year's Eve
videos.overview: For the past few years, Arthur kept on trying to stay up until midnight for the new year, but he always fell asleep. This year he decides to not stay up at all, until his friends tell him what happens every year. But they all have different stories.

videos.title: Arthur Meets Mr. Rogers
videos.overview: Mr. Rogers from Mr. Rogers Neighborhood comes to the Read family for a visit.

videos.title: Draw!
videos.overview: After Francine makes fun of Fern for liking Mr. Ratburn's puppet shows, Fern gets revenge by drawing an unflattering comic strip making fun of Francine, and pretty soon, everyone else tries it too.

videos.title: Binky Barnes, Art Expert
videos.overview: Binky gets teamed up with Arthur and Buster for an art class assignment. They go to an art museum and Binky discovers a mistake with a certain drawing-

videos.title: Arthur's Lucky Pencil
videos.overview: Arthur uses a pencil that seems to be lucky and then lends it to his friends. But it gets shorter and shorter, so Arthur decides to use it for emergencies only.

videos.title: D.W., the Picky Eater
videos.overview: D.W. is not invited to Grandma Thora's upcoming birthday dinner because she is a very picky eater.

videos.title: Buster and the Daredevils
videos.overview: Arthur and Buster want Toby and Slink to teach them some skating tricks, but Toby and Slink say that they have to do some dares first. Arthur quits before the first dare, but Buster keeps on fulfilling dare after dare.

videos.title: Arthur Makes a Movie
videos.overview: Arthur wants to see a movie, but he is too young, so he and his friends make a parody of the movie.

videos.title: Go to Your Room, D.W.
videos.overview: D.W. does not get along well with Kate, whom she claims keeps trying to take her toys, when they are supposed to be sharing them. When Kate will not give D.W. one of her toys back, D.W. tries to take the toy away from Kate by force and threatens to pinch her. For doing this, Jane sends D.W. upstairs to her room as punishment.

videos.title: Arthur's Underwear
videos.overview: Arthur has an embarrassing dream about being seen in his underwear and it gets even worse when it happens for real.

videos.title: Buster Baxter, Cat Saver
videos.overview: Buster saves a cat from up a tree and now he is known as a local hero because of an article in the newspaper.

videos.title: Arthur's TV-Free Week
videos.overview: Everyone has all pledged not to watch TV for one whole week.

videos.title: Arthur vs. the Piano
videos.overview: Arthur gets stage fright during a rehearsal. Will he be able to get through his recital without any mistakes?

videos.title: The Big Blow-Up
videos.overview: Can Francine and the Brain put aside their differences for the good of the soccer team? Probably not - so Arthur and Buster decide to "write" some wrongs.

videos.title: Lost!
videos.overview: Arthur gets on the wrong bus to his swimming lessons and gets lost.

videos.title: The Short, Quick Summer
videos.overview: Arthur has a to-do list for the summer, but he can't find it and summer's nearly over. He finds out everyone else had a great summer. He finds his list and D.W. accidentally helps him realize that he did all the things on it and had a great time too.

videos.title: D.W. Goes to Washington
videos.overview: It's the first family trip and Arthur gets to choose. He chooses going to Washington, D.C. and D.W. thinks that she's going to be bored until she accidentally runs into the American president.

videos.title: Arthur's Mystery Envelope
videos.overview: Mr. Haney gives Arthur an envelope to give to his mom. He is worried about its contents, thinking that it's about him, so he comes up with a way of giving it to her without her opening it. It turns out to contain Mr. Haney's tax documents.

videos.title: D.W.'s Deer Friend
videos.overview: It's the second family trip and D.W. gets to choose. She chooses camping and D.W. gets attached to a deer she met and wants to bring home.

videos.title: Buster Hits the Books
videos.overview: Buster needs to write a book report, but he has never finished a book. His friends try to find one he can finish.

videos.title: Arthur's Faraway Friend
videos.overview: Arthur and Buster are on the urge of finishing their story for the sequel of Robin Hood. Everything is well until Arthur discovers that Buster has decided to go on a long trip to bond with his dad. Arthur fears that it's the end of their story and their friendship!

videos.title: Arthur and the Square Dance
videos.overview: The gang convinces Arthur and Francine that the two are in love. When they're partners for square dancing, they avoid one another to keep from catching cooties.

videos.title: Water and the Brain
videos.overview: Arthur and his friends are all invited by Muffy to go to Waterworld, but the Brain doesn't want to go. When he and Binky find out that the Brain is afraid of water, they try to cure this fear so they can all go together.

videos.title: Arthur the Unfunny
videos.overview: Arthur's a notorious joke-killer. But when he's scheduled to perform as a carnival clown, Arthur decides he'll learn how to make people laugh -- or else!

videos.title: Sue Ellen's Lost Diary
videos.overview: When Sue Ellen drops her diary at the library, she is worried that someone has found it and is going to read it.

videos.title: Arthur's Knee
videos.overview: Arthur does not want to tell his mother he hurt his knee, because then she will know he was playing down at the dump—where he is not supposed to go.

videos.title: Grandma Thora Appreciation Day
videos.overview: Arthur and D.W. sleepover at Grandma Thora's house and find out that she gets lonely when they're not there. So Arthur and D.W. throw her a party to help her.

videos.title: Fern's Slumber Party
videos.overview: Fern's mom suggests that she have a slumber party. The kids are sure it will be a night to forget, and sure enough, disaster strikes - until Fern's special talents save the night.

videos.title: Love Notes for Muffy
videos.overview: When Muffy annoys Francine and Brain, they decide to get even with her by sending her fake love notes for an anonymous person to make her look goofy.

videos.title: D.W. Blows the Whistle
videos.overview: Deputized as a Junior Safety Officer, D.W. sees it as a license to tattle.

videos.title: Francine Redecorates
videos.overview: When Francine and Katherine get sick of each other Katherine moves out to have her own room in the living room.

videos.title: Arthur the Loser
videos.overview: Arthur keeps losing at the new No Guessing! board game and other things as well, so he starts cheating to win.

videos.title: Arthur vs. the Very Mean Crossing Guard
videos.overview: On the way home from school, Arthur and the Brain meet a crossing guard who wants $10.00 from them to cross the street.

videos.title: D.W.'s Name Game
videos.overview: D.W. gets praise from the Tibbles at being the best at name-calling, so she tries it on Arthur but it fails because he's older and knows more words so with the help of Katherine she looks up words in the Thesaurus that Arthur doesen't know and uses them against him.

videos.title: Finders Key-pers
videos.overview: Arthur, Brain, and Binky find a mysterious key int he grass at school. An agreement to share the key turns ugly when each decides he wants the key for himself.

videos.title: How the Cookie Crumbles
videos.overview: Muffy won last year's Strawberry baking contest in The Strawberry Festival because her father was the judge but this year when her friends help her bake strawberry cookies she takes the credit and wins the contest. Soon the cookies become so good that Muffy decides to run a business and sell them but not before she lets Arthur and friends get their share.

videos.title: Sue Ellen's Little Sister
videos.overview: When Sue Ellen wishes she had a little sister, Arthur and Francine both offer to lend her theirs.

videos.title: Buster's Back
videos.overview: Buster returns after a extremely long trip to bond with his father and a nervous Arthur wonders if Buster's trip made him change.

videos.title: The Ballad of Buster Baxter
videos.overview: Buster feels left out having missed all the adventures since he was away. He feels that everyone has changed and they feel the same about him, so Arthur plans a party so they can rekindle their friendship with Buster.

videos.title: D.W., All Fired Up
videos.overview: D.W. loves school and wants to go everyday, but when Ms. Morgan starts doing fire drills she fears for her safety and doesn't want to go anymore.

videos.title: I'd Rather Read It Myself
videos.overview: The Tibble Twins can do everything better than D.W. So she tells them that she is able to read before them. They challenge her and she picks up a book and makes up a story, but when the Tibble's bring the book home for their Grandma to read to them her trick is revealed.

videos.title: Arthur Goes Crosswire
videos.overview: Mr. Ratburn assigns partners for a project and Arthur gets teamed up with Muffy. After spending a lot of time with her, he starts to act just like her.

videos.title: Sue Ellen and the Brainasaurous
videos.overview: Sue Ellen gets partnered with Brain in another project by Mr. Ratburn. Soon he starts to be a report hog and gets on Sue Ellen's nerves.

videos.title: Background Blues
videos.overview: Mr. Ratburn assigns a project that involves family ancestors.  Muffy and Francine turn this project into a competition to see who has the best ancestors.

videos.title: And Now Let's Talk to Some Kids
videos.overview: Arthur's class gets picked to be on a television show in which the Brain does not want to go on.

videos.title: The Chips Are Down
videos.overview: D.W. eats a big green potato chip and to get her off his back Arthur tells her that it's fatal and she could die. So D.W. spends this day as her last day until she finds out the truth.

videos.title: Revenge of the Chip
videos.overview: D.W's mom tells the newspapers and everyone in town that story about D.W. and the green chip embarrassing her ultimately.

videos.title: Binky Rules
videos.overview: Someone has been writing "Binky Rules" all over Lakewood Elementary and Mr. Morris thinks it is Binky.  Binky says he didn't do it, so Fern and Buster are trying to find out.

videos.title: Meet Binky
videos.overview: Everyone gets tickets for a concert starring the new group Binky.

videos.title: Arthur Rides the Bandwagon
videos.overview: Everyone has a Woogle, the popular new toy... everyone except Arthur.  He think that they're dweeby, until everyone else has one.

videos.title: Dad's Dessert Dilemma
videos.overview: After one of Mr. Read's scrumptious desserts makes Arthur the most popular kid in class, Arthur can't stop asking his dad to cook. Despite his dad's busy catering schedule, Arthur promises delectable desserts to anyone and everyone.

videos.title: Popular Girls
videos.overview: After Fern and Sue Ellen take a quiz in a teen magazine, they change the way they act.  Fern turns loud and aggressive, while Sue Ellen falls back in everything.

videos.title: Buster's Growing Grudge
videos.overview: When Binky steals Buster's joke for his report, Buster has a grudge against him.

videos.title: Arthur's Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: When Buster finds an arrowhead in his yard; everyone wants to know if there are treasures in their yards.

videos.title: The Return of the King
videos.overview: When Mr. Ratburn's class goes to a medieval style fair, his old teacher Mr. Pryce-Jones comes with his new class. Mr. Pryce-Jones' class wins all the games.

videos.title: Attack of the Turbo Tibbles
videos.overview: The Tibble's watch a dangerous superhero show and imitate it. Things get out of hand when they pretend that D.W. is a bad guy.

videos.title: D.W. Tricks The Tooth Fairy
videos.overview: D.W. wants money to buy a toy, so she plans to trick the tooth fairy so she can earn enough money for it.

videos.title: Double Tibble Trouble
videos.overview: Tommy Tibble gets sick and Timmy Tibble gets sad so D.W. and Emily pretend to be Tibbles to make Timmy feel better until Tommy is well.

videos.title: Arthur's Almost Live Not Real Music Festival
videos.overview: Arthur and Buster show D.W. that you don't need cameras, lights, etc. to make a music video.

videos.title: What Scared Sue Ellen?
videos.overview: After everyone has told scary stories, everything scares Sue Ellen.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Dogs and Babies

videos.title: Friday the 13th

videos.title: Cast Away

Muffy's sales tactics soon result in great sales, but border on dishonesty and leave Arthur facing an important moral decision.

Worried, however, that she got one of the details wrong, she sets out to correct her error in a dream.

videos.title: Brain's Shocking Secret

He discovers that D.W. is frightened by some very unusual things.

She has no idea how she's going to come up with five pages on the Pilgrims' eating habits, until Brain shows her how to use a search engine to find information about the subject on the Internet. She copies the contents of an entire article and hands it in as her report, looking forward to a relaxing holiday. She then learns from her sister that what she's done is plagiarism and could get her suspended from school.

videos.title: Buster Gets Real
videos.overview: Everyone is into the new supermarket reality show on TV - except Arthur. When Buster stops watching Bionic Bunny in favor of the new show, Arthur fears their friendship is over.

videos.title: D.W. on Ice
videos.overview: When Emily announces a skating party to celebrate mid-winter, D.W. brags about being a great skater. She feels she's so good that she even offers lessons to James, who is worried about his skating skills. D.W., however, is overconfident, having only gone ice-skating three times in her life. She begins to learn that sometimes it takes practice to be good at something.

videos.title: Spoiled Rotten!
videos.overview: When Muffy's friends accuse her of being spoiled, she tries to prove them wrong by being the most charitable person around. Francine is unimpressed until Muffy discovers the true meaning of charity.

videos.title: Big Brother Binky
videos.overview: When Binky's parents tell him that they're adopting from China, he isn't sure what to make of it at first. He learns that "adopting" means that he's going to become an actual big brother to a baby girl and will be heading to China to meet his new sister. Binky eagerly assists with preparations for the big trip and the new arrival, but begins to become concerned that his parents will no longer have any time for him. After his worries are eased, the big moment finally comes. At first, Binky is ill at ease around his new sister, who seems to cry a lot, but then discovers a special talent. Back at home, he's eager to show off his new talent to his friends, but finds that he seems to have lost it.

videos.title: Is That Kosher?
videos.overview: Francine's convinced that she can fast on Yom Kippur just like her older sister. But then Arthur wins a free pizza party for all his friends for that very same day! Will Francine be able to resist?

videos.title: Never, Never, Never
videos.overview: When D.W's extra toys fall into the hands of the destructive Tibble twins, she worries that no one loves her anymore - until Arthur comes to the rescue and proves that giving gifts isn't the only way of showing you care.

videos.title: Room to Ride
videos.overview: Binky really enjoys riding his bike, both for fun and as a means of getting to school and back. Binky is devastated when his mother forbids him from riding on the potholed streets after he comes home injured.

videos.title: D.W.'s Stray Netkitin
videos.overview: D.W. enjoys taking care of her Netkitten, but finds herself cut off when the Read family computer suffers from not one, but two computer viruses.

videos.title: Bats in the Belfry
videos.overview: Arthur and D.W. are thrilled when Grandma Thora lets them turn her attic into a clubhouse.

videos.title: For the Birds
videos.overview: Brain is delighted when he learns that the green-tailed grebe, a bird previously believed to be extinct, has been sighted in the forests of Elwood City. He's determined to be the first to take photographic evidence of it, but becomes worried when Mr. Ratburn starts a bird-watching club.

videos.title: Ungifted
videos.overview: Arthur and Buster’s friendship is put to the test when Arthur gives away a present that Buster had given him for his birthday.

videos.title: The Chronicles of Buster
videos.overview: Buster is enthralled by the new Collector's Edition of The Chronicles of Amayzzia, so much so that it seems like it's all that he can talk about.

videos.title: On This Spot
videos.overview: Arthur is thrilled to learn that Sitting Bull ones passed through Elwood City!

videos.title: The Cherry Tree
videos.overview: Muffy will do anything to get a bouncy castle for her party - even chop down a cherry tree.

videos.title: Matchmaker, Matchbreaker
videos.overview: Francine and Muffy play matchmaker with their siblings Chip and Catherine.

videos.title: War of the Worms
videos.overview: Brain is always taking the fun out of Fern’s storytelling by correcting her facts. She decides to teach him a lesson by spinning a tall tale that he can’t help but believe. Fern convinces Brain that there are giant worms attacking Elwood City!

videos.title: I Owe You One
videos.overview: Buster’s always asking Arthur for favors. One day he worries at the thought of having to repay them all at once, so Buster goes on a favor-repaying frenzy.

videos.title: The Blackout
videos.overview: It’s the hottest day in Elwood City, when a total blackout leaves its residents without any electricity.

videos.title: Mei Lin Takes a Stand
videos.overview: Binky’s baby sister Mei-Lin isn’t keen on learning to talk and would rather stick to crawling.

videos.title: The Perfect Game
videos.overview: Francine is excited for Mr. Ratburn’s coolest assignment yet. He’s asked them to design their very own model cities!

videos.title: D.W.'s Furry Freakout
videos.overview: D.W. finds a stray kitten and begs to keep it. After All, Arthur has his own dog!

videos.title: No Acting Please
videos.overview: When Fern lands a role in the Elwood City community production of It Began With a Whistle, she fears that she is not talented enough to be a star actress.

videos.title: Prunella Deegan and the Disappointing Ending
videos.overview: The final volume of the Henry Screever series is released at last. Prunella and Marina compete to see who will be first to finish the book.

videos.title: The Silent Treatment
videos.overview: George wonders whether anyone would notice if he just disappeared, and so vows not to speak until someone notices him. Of course, his friends do notice, and they decide to cheer him up with a surprise party.

videos.title: Kung Fool
videos.overview: While volunteering to help an elderly neighbour with his household chores, Fern discovers his past life as a kung fu celebrity.

videos.title: Arthur's Number Nightmare
videos.overview: When Arthur and the gang suspect they are being ranked at school, they become obsessed with what the numbers mean.

videos.title: Brain Gets Hooked
videos.overview: Brain gets hooked on the latest tween reality show, Junior Island. He knows he has a problem when he starts to ignore his friends and his schoolwork. But what can he do to break the addiction?

videos.title: MacFrensky
videos.overview: When Francine and the Brain are locked in a stiff competition to win Student of the Month, Muffy talks Francine into 'borrowing' Buster's toy and letting Brain take the blame for it. As the lies grow and the prize gets closer, however, Francine's guilt increases.

videos.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Binky
videos.overview: As Emily's new babysitter, Binky introduces his charge to the world of pro-wrestling, and teaches her some fierce moves. But when Emily starts ruffling the feathers of other pre-schoolers on the playground, Binky worries that he has not been the best role model.

videos.title: The Great MacGrady
videos.overview: When Lakewood Elementary's beloved lunch lady Mrs. MacGrady is diagnosed with cancer, Arthur and his friends all react differently to the news.

videos.title: When Carl met George
videos.overview: George is excited about spending time with his new friend Carl, who seems to know all kind of cool facts about trains and about... well lots of things! Then George learns that Carl has Asperger's Syndrome - a form of autism that makes Carl see the world differently than most people.

videos.title: D.W. Swims with the Fishes
videos.overview: D.W. and James enter the pre-school swim meet and recruit their big siblings to coach them. All goes swimmingly until Arthur and Molly start taking their jobs a little too seriously.

videos.title: The Portrait of the Artist as a Young Tibble
videos.overview: The Tibbles sell their art works to raise money for a toy by using pity.

videos.title: The Secret Guardians
videos.overview: When Arthur, Binky, and Sue Ellen stumble upon a beautiful and private woodland oasis right by their homes, they vow to tell no one and keep it as their secret spot.

videos.title: Fernlets by Fern
videos.overview: Fern and Muffy start a greeting card business. Muffy paints the covers and Fern writes the poems. All the work makes Fern lose interest in writing, so she tries to figure out how to get make it interesting again.

videos.title: Prunella and the Haunted Locker
videos.overview: Prunella is assigned a new school locker, which is rumored to be haunted! She refuses to believe it… until mysterious and unexplained things star to happen.

videos.title: Paradise Lost
videos.overview: Baby Kate begins to learn to talk, but starts to not be able to understand Pal anymore. They go to the Dolly Llama for an answer.

videos.title: Looking for Bonnie
videos.overview: Famous rock musician Dean Lomax visits Elwood City and calls on George's dad to fix his equally famous guitar named Bonnie.

videos.title: The Secret Origin of Supernova
videos.overview: Arthur is dismayed when he learns an energy drink endorsed by his favorite comic book character is full of sugar - it doesn’t give you any special energy or magic powers at all!

videos.title: The Wheel Deal
videos.overview: Brain learns how to play basketball while in a wheelchair from a girl named Lydia.

videos.title: The Buster Report
videos.overview: The kids have to write a report about someone they admire. To everyone's surprise, most especially Buster's, George picks... Buster!

videos.title: The Agent of Change
videos.overview: Annoyed by gender stereotypes in the media, Francine, Muffy and Molly make their own little animated movie with girls as the main characters.

videos.title: D.W. Unties the Knot
videos.overview: After watching “The Wedding Channel,” D.W. wants to get married!

videos.overview: There’s a virus spreading through Lakewood Elementary! It changes the way everyone acts and how they treat each other… it’s the new nicknames! Can Brain stop the virus he created?

videos.title: The Play's the Thing
videos.overview: The playground has been quiet lately - too quiet - and the Tough Customers don’t like it one bit. All the rest of the kids seem more interested in electronics than good old-fashioned fun!

videos.title: Falafelosophy
videos.overview: Sue Ellen writes a graphic novel about circles and triangles. However her friends think it's unusual.

videos.title: The Great Lint Rush
videos.overview: Mr. Toad is back! And he’s ready to corner the Sock Market, leaving everyone in Elwood City barefoot and bereft.

videos.title: Tales of Grotesquely Grim Bunny
videos.overview: Arthur, Buster and Fern buy one Grotesquely Grim Bunny comic after the local comic store goes under new management. Arthur is afraid to admit the new comics scare him.

videos.title: Pet Projects
videos.overview: Arthur and Francine enter their pets to compete against each other int he “Perfect Pet” video contest.

videos.title: Follow the Bouncing Ball
videos.overview: When Alberto and Francine accidentally exchange soccer balls in the park, Alberto's ball travels with Francine throughout Elwood City and, eventually, the world.

videos.title: Buster Baxter & the Letter from the Sea
videos.overview: Buster is convinced that a message in a bottle came from the lost city of Atlantis.

videos.overview: In an attempt to discover just how big the world is, Pal, Kate, Mei-Lin, and Amigo take an imaginary trip around the world.

videos.title: Muffy and the Big Bad Blog
videos.overview: Muffy discovers that web blogging is a great way to keep her readers up to date with her every move.

videos.title: Arthur Unravels
videos.overview: Arthur's Grandmother teaches him how to knit. However, embarrassed by his new skill, he tries to hide it from everyone else.

videos.overview: Creating a fad is a lot harder than it looks! All of Muffy’s hot new trends turn out to be lukewarm flops. Will Muffy learn that it’s just better to be yourself?

videos.overview: When D.W. gets her hair cut too short by a clown barber, the Tibbles begin to tease her about it, prompting her to seek advice on comebacks.

videos.overview: D.W.’s new classmate, Sheikh, is Brian’s young cousin… and is also from Senegal.

videos.title: Buster Spaces Out
videos.overview: Buster decides to build a model rocket ship.

videos.title: The Long Road Home
videos.overview: After costing Lakewood Elementary the win in a relay race against Mighty Mountain, George wants to redeem himself.

videos.title: Fifteen
videos.overview: Arthur has fifteen minutes to get back home get his report and get back to school before class starts.

videos.title: I Wanna Hold Your Hand
videos.overview: George sees Binky hold his mother's hand. Binky doesn't want anyone else to know.

videos.overview: Everyone knows the Tibbles are exactly the same. So if they are supposed to be exactly the same, why can Tommy whistle while Timmy can’t? Does this mean one twin is better than the other?

videos.title: Buster's Secret Admirer
videos.overview: Buster receives chocolates in the mail from a "secret admirer" and tries to uncover who it was sent by.

videos.title: The Last King of Lambland
videos.overview: James receives a gift from his uncle in Scotland - a toy that will supposedly give its owner the powers of the legendary James the Squinty, leader of the clan MacDoogal-Donal’s!

videos.overview: Mr. Ratburn decides to have his students learn a lesson about handling money. Telling them that they can't spend any money for the weekend and have to barter for what they want.

videos.overview: A new candy bar that Buster wants to try is making anyone who eats the candy bar act strange.

videos.title: S.W.E.A.T.
videos.overview: It’s time for the kids at Lakewood Elementary to take the Stoddard-Wilkins Elementary Aptitude Test, or “S.W.E.A.T”

videos.overview: Prunella receives help from her friends to clean out her closet. She has kept everything since she was a baby, making her closet very full.

videos.title: What's in a Name?
videos.overview: Binky finds out that his real name isn’t Binky, it’s… Shelly?! He’s certain he will have to leave town - or at least school - having this silly name.

videos.title: Muffy's Classy Classics Club
videos.overview: Muffy starts a book club. Things don't go over so well when she starts picking out all the books for the club members to read.

videos.title: Best Enemies
videos.overview: Muffy’s feelings are hurt when her friends criticize her favorite book series.

videos.overview: Fritz asks Buster to take care of the community garden for him while he recovers from his ankle injury. Buster has to stop short when he finds out he's going on a camping trip with his mother. So, he asks Muffy, Francine and Arthur to care for the garden for him.

videos.overview: Buster is excited for the cooking class carpool until it turns out to be a little too crowded.

As she continues with her tales, the stories begin to repeat, and the kids are noticing. Ladonna begins to fabricate her stories and is caught by the Brain when she makes an actual mistake.

videos.title: Flippity Francine
videos.overview: Muffy videotapes Francine attempting a soccer stunt that goes horribly wrong, and uploads it online, where it becomes increasingly popular. Francine is initially embarrassed, but when she sees how popular she is, she begins to let the fame go to her head.

videos.title: Muffy Takes the Wheel
videos.overview: It’s the 1st Annual Lakewood Derby and Muffy’s revved up! But when she enlists her dad to help her make the winning car, he completely takes over. Can Muffy hit the brakes on this runaway project?

videos.title: All About DW
videos.overview: D.W. get jealous when Emily gets to be Little Red Riding hood and D.W. has to be tree number two.

videos.title: Blockheads
videos.overview: D.W. and Emily become obsessed with building their dream house out of blocks.

videos.title: Get Smart
videos.overview: Mr. Ratburn must prove that his answers are correct and that a 100% accurate computer's answers are wrong.

videos.title: Baby Steps
videos.overview: Mei Lin can say "hello" AND play the piano?!? Kate can't even wave! Worried about her sister's future, D.W. enlists the help of Brain.

videos.title: Night of the Tibble
videos.overview: The Tibble twins are having their first sleepover and invite James over.

videos.title: Read and Flumbergast
videos.overview: A cupcake's been stolen! The primary suspect: Tommy Tibble. D.W. gathers a jury and demands that justice be served. Can D.W. get Tommy to confess? Or will she lose control?

videos.title: The Last Tough Customer
videos.overview: The Tough Customers have to change their ways. Molly might not be able to do so.

videos.title: Brain's Chess Mess
videos.overview: In order to improve his game for a competition Brain forms a chess club.

videos.title: Baseball Blues
videos.overview: George can't wait to play baseball.

videos.title: Brain's Biggest Blunder
videos.overview: Brain teaches Buster arithmetic.

videos.title: Buster's Book Battle
videos.overview: Buster starts reading books in order to earn points to win prizes.

videos.title: On the Buster Scale
videos.overview: Buster and Brain disagree over movie reviews.

videos.title: Fern and the Case of the Stolen Story
videos.overview: Suffering from a case of writers' block, Fern begins to copy some of Ladonna's stories.

videos.overview: Sue Ellen makes a change in her diet, prompting Muffy and Francine to try and imitate her vegetarianism.

videos.title: So Funny I Forgot to Laugh
videos.overview: Arthur's teasing of Sue Ellen's new sweater makes her feel bad.

videos.title: The Best Day Ever
videos.overview: Everyone remembers their best days.

videos.overview: It's the Elwood City Dog Show and Killer is facing off against Sebastian Winkleplotz, the snobby, championship-winning poodle.

videos.overview: Arthur agrees to watch his neighbor's dog Amigo while Alberto is away. However, when Arthur is looking after Amigo, Pal feels he is losing his rank as top dog of the house.

videos.overview: D.W. and Bud embark on an epic wilderness adventure! Dense jungles, mystic ruins, the backyard has never been so exciting!

videos.overview: Arthur and Buster have always been best friends. But when a leaky roof forces Arthur to study in Buster's room, they discover they make better friends then roommates.

videos.overview: Tired of doing chores, Arthur and the gang decide to invent their own country: Kidonia.

videos.overview: When a mouse is discovered in the Read house, Arthur uses Nemo to try get rid of it, making Pal worried. Then, Ladonna shows up and shows Arthur, D.W., and Bud that mice can be friends as well as foes.

videos.overview: Muffy, Binky, and Ladonna find Carl's lost kite and they argue over who should take possession of it.

videos.title: The Director's Cut
videos.overview: After meeting his hero, George is inspired to make a movie of his own, but he doesn't seem to be getting his own way in it.

videos.title: Crime and Consequences
videos.overview: When George accidentally breaks the class's prize woodworking project, Binky gets unfairly blamed.

videos.title: Caught In the Crosswires
videos.overview: Muffy is thrilled when mega producer J3 chooses her family for his latest reality TV project.

videos.title: Framed!
videos.overview: Buster has just won the best young artist award at the Elwood City Arts Festival. Sensing his work might be worth something someday, Muffy hires Buster to paint her portrait.

videos.title: Binky's Music Madness

videos.title: Brain Freeze
videos.overview: A new ice cream shop has just opened up across the block. With whimsical flavor names, futuristic furniture, and a cute mascot named Puk Puk, Yumbobo is threatening to put Brain's shop out of business.

videos.title: The Friend Who Wasn't There
videos.overview: After she hears D.W. talking to her imaginary friend, Muffy tries to find her own.

videos.title: Surprise!
videos.overview: When she is un-invited to Catherine's sixteenth birthday party, Francine tries to to make it the worst party ever.

videos.overview: George is concerned about Fern when she falls into a state of sadness, but doesn't know why. Wanting to get to the bottom of the mystery, he enlists Buster Baxter to investigate.

videos.overview: Timmy is outraged when he discovers Tommy was born two minutes before he was, leading to Tommy acting like a superior to Timmy.

videos.overview: After Binky wrecks the 18th hole at a miniature golf course, Muffy, Buster and Binky attempt to create a new 18th hole.
